messages.subject: Shiny "01_hello" load problem in Rstudio-server with shiny 5

I've been successfully running shiny in Rstudio-server on my CentOS 6.3 system for several weeks now. I recently upgraded to shiny v5 via the standard package update. As a basic post-install test, I tried to load the simple "01_hello" example. For some reason, it's no longer loading.

Any ideas as to how/why shiny is not working "out of the box" for me after installing the latest shiny v5?

Thanks!
